notes.note: Reviewed against #2964's change to packages/cli/src/commands/lifecycle.ts: `station start`'s two TCP listener waits (serverPort + 1 terminal, serverPort + 2 voice) now take the same bounded slow-boot extension as the identity waits (45 s, at most twice, only while the child is alive) and stop when the child exits. Searched this page for the readiness waits, their deadline, the 'Timed out waiting for TCP listener' message and the terminal/voice ports: it makes no claim about start-up readiness timing, and the ports themselves and their derivation are unchanged.
